title: Azodicarbonamide (ADA): FDA Status, International Bans & Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on azodicarbonamide (ADA), the 'yoga mat chemical' — FDA-approved under 21 CFR 172.806 at 45 ppm but banned in the EU, UK, Australia, and Singapore. Now on FDA's post-market reassessment priority list under MAHA, with Texas school meal bans and warning label requirements taking effect in 2026-2027.
